pages.text: Alchemy has three steps: $(thing)form the embryo$(), $(thing)refine it in heat$(), then $(thing)take the pill at the right stage$(). This chapter visibly presents all three embryo recipes, two furnace recipes, three Immortal Furnace recipes and both Immortal Pill recipes—no missing page replaced by an internal ID.

pages.title: Crude Pill Embryo
pages.text: Combine one TruePower/ImmortalPower crafting material with wheat, shapelessly, for eight embryos. The embryo only restores hunger; it grants no lingqi.

pages.title: Crude Pill · Furnace
pages.text: A vanilla furnace refines one pill in 50 ticks and grants no experience.

pages.heading: Crude Pill · Immortal Furnace
pages.body: The result matches the vanilla furnace; the Immortal Furnace adds parallel lanes and plugin-driven processing speed.

pages.title: Crude Pill
pages.text: Fast and edible at full hunger: restores 3 hunger, adds 10 lingqi and grants one Lingqi Saturation layer for 5 seconds. If a layer already existed before use, it also deals 1 magic damage.

pages.title: Refined Pill Embryo
pages.text: Place a Crude Pill in the center, alternating wheat and TruePower/ImmortalPower materials around it. The edible embryo gives 80 lingqi, two saturation layers for 15 seconds and deals 5 magic damage.

pages.title: Refined Pill · Furnace
pages.text: A vanilla furnace needs only 25 ticks and grants no experience.

pages.heading: Refined Pill · Immortal Furnace
pages.body: This route also yields one pill. Plugins shorten processing; they never multiply this furnace recipe's output.

pages.title: Refined Pill
pages.text: Fast and edible at full hunger: restores 4 hunger, adds 120 lingqi, grants one saturation layer for 10 seconds and deals 5 magic damage. It is the heart of a Breakthrough Pill Embryo.

pages.title: Breakthrough Pill Embryo
pages.text: Center a Spirit Crystal, place four Refined Pills on the cardinal sides and TruePower/ImmortalPower materials in the corners. This embryo cannot be eaten; it belongs in an Immortal Furnace.

pages.heading: Breakthrough Pill
pages.body: Neither the vanilla furnace nor the blast furnace accepts this embryo.

pages.title: Breaking a Boundary
pages.text: At stages 1–4 it advances one stage, grants five saturation layers and two minutes of Advancement Weakness; each existing layer first deals 20 magic damage. At stage 5 it fills lingqi. At stages 6–8 it adds half the ImmortalPower cap; higher stages still gain one saturation layer.

pages.title: Immortal Pill · Two Formulas
pages.text: The left accepts TruePower or ImmortalPower materials around a Dragon Egg. The right centers a Breakthrough Pill inside eight ImmortalPower and accepts no substitute.

pages.title: Immortal Pill
pages.text: At full stage-five lingqi, it leaves one health and opens stage six; taking it earlier or unprepared is lethal. At later stages it grants two saturation layers for one minute and ImmortalPower: half the cap at stages 6–8, 3,200 at stage 9, and 25,600 at stage 10 by default.

pages.title: Ascension Dan · Not Crafted
pages.text: End City treasure has a 1% chance to contain one. It sends a cultivator below stage six directly to stage six and has no crafting or furnace recipe.

pages.title: White Day Thunder · Special
pages.text: Using it sets the player directly to stage ten. It has no survival recipe and exists for Creative, administration or modpack-authored progression.
